# @aponiajs/mvc

> Inertia component and prop protocol for React/Vue/Svelte, plus multi-framework delivery bridges.

## Exports

- `Inertia(component, options?)`: route decorator that answers the Inertia protocol
- `createInertiaResponse(component, props, request, options?)`
- `inertia(component, props, context, options?)`
- `createNextHandler`, `createNuxtHandler`, `createAngularHandler`
- `toExpressHandler`, `toFastifyHandler`
- Types: `InertiaPage`, `InertiaOptions`, `NextServerApp`, `NuxtRendererApp`, `AngularCommonEngine`
